name: @projexlight/sdk-assignment
summary: Assignment authority for field-service operations: claims dispatched tasks under a lease, balances workload across techs within a territory, and supports re-assignment with full audit trail. Decoupled from sdk-dispatch so the same authority can serve multiple dispatch sources (call center, storm, scheduled visits, customer self-serve).

events.name: assignment.assignment.claimed.v1
events.description: Authority took a lease on a dispatch task for a specific tech; carries lease_expires_at.

events.name: assignment.assignment.released.v1
events.description: Lease released (tech declined, lease expired, or supervisor reclaimed).

events.name: assignment.assignment.reassigned.v1
events.description: Active assignment moved from one tech to another; carries reason + supervisor persona.

events.name: assignment.workload.rebalanced.v1
events.description: Workload-balancer pass redistributed pending assignments across techs in a territory.

models.description: Per-claim row: dispatch_task_id, assigned_to_persona, lease_expires_at, status (claimed/released/completed).
Geo polygon + assigned techs + escalation chain; supports nested + overlapping territories.
Per-(tech, day) workload snapshot used by the balancer: assigned_count, completed_count, drive_minutes.

hooks.name: claimTask
hooks.description: Lease a dispatchable task for a tech. Atomic — refuses if already claimed. Lease default 30 min, refreshable.

hooks.name: releaseAssignment
hooks.description: Release a lease (tech declined / shift ending / supervisor reclaim). Re-queues the task.

hooks.name: reassignTask
hooks.description: Move an active assignment to a different tech with a reason + supervisor persona. Audited.

hooks.name: rebalanceTerritory
hooks.description: Balancer pass — redistribute pending assignments across techs whose workload variance exceeds a threshold.

hooks.name: startLeaseSweeper
hooks.description: Background worker — releases expired leases so other techs can claim them. Safe to leave running in dev.

scenarios.title: Tech opens mobile app → claims next task in territory
scenarios.when_to_use: Standard pull-style assignment. Tech taps 'next job'; authority finds the highest-priority queued task in their territory + leases it.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Lease row written with status='claimed' + 30-min TTL. Emits .claimed.v1 which sdk-dispatch reacts to (marks task dispatched). Tech sees the job in their mobile app.

scenarios.title: Tech doesn't act on claimed task → lease sweeper recycles it
scenarios.when_to_use: Tech claimed a task, then went offline. Sweeper releases the lease + emits .released.v1 so the queue picks it up for another tech.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Stale lease rows transition to 'released'. Emits .released.v1 which sdk-dispatch reacts to (re-queues the task). Original tech notified that the lease expired.

scenarios.title: Supervisor pulls a tech off a job + reassigns to senior
scenarios.when_to_use: Job escalates mid-route (complex repair); supervisor reassigns to a senior tech with the skill set. Audited handoff for blame-storm later if needed.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Assignment moved; original tech notified. Emits .reassigned.v1 to the audit chain — supervisor reason + persona pinned forever.

scenarios.title: Balancer evens out workload across 8 techs in a territory
scenarios.when_to_use: Storm aftermath — some techs ended up with 12 tasks, others with 3. Balancer redistributes pending assignments so per-tech workload variance drops below threshold.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Returns the list of (assignment, from_tech, to_tech) moves applied. Emits .workload.rebalanced.v1 summarizing the pass. Affected techs get push notifications.

scenarios.title: Customer cancels job → assignment auto-releases
scenarios.when_to_use: Reactive on dispatch.task.cancelled.v1 — drop the matching assignment + free the lease so the tech doesn't drive out for nothing.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Active assignment row marked 'released'; emits .released.v1. Tech receives a push notification + the route auto-re-materializes minus the cancelled stop.

compliance_posture.notes: Per-assignment audit (claim, release, reassignment) is the GDPR Art-30 record-of-processing for tech allocation decisions. Workload snapshots persisted long enough to satisfy labor-law inquiries. Reassignment reason + supervisor persona pinned to defeat 'who pulled me off the job' disputes.
